parameters.name: AccessLogEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable access log collection. Valid values:

- `true`: enables access log collection.

- `false`: disables access log collection.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: AccessLogFile
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable access logs. Valid values:

- `""`: disables access logs.

- `/dev/stdout`: enables access logs.

parameters.name: AccessLogFormat
parameters.description: The custom format of access logs. This parameter is ignored if access log collection is disabled. The value must be a JSON string. The JSON string must contain the following keys: authority\_for, bytes\_received, bytes\_sent, downstream\_local\_address, downstream\_remote\_address, duration, istio\_policy\_status, method, path, protocol, requested\_server\_name, response\_code, response\_flags, route\_name, start\_time, trace\_id, upstream\_cluster, upstream\_host, upstream\_local\_address, upstream\_service\_time, upstream\_transport\_failure\_reason, user\_agent, and x\_forwarded\_for.

parameters.name: AccessLogGatewayEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the ASM gateway to Simple Log Service.

parameters.name: AccessLogGatewayLifecycle
parameters.description: The retention period of the access logs of the ingress gateway that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days.

parameters.name: AccessLogProject
parameters.description: The custom SLS project to which access logs are collected.

parameters.name: AccessLogServiceEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the gRPC Access Log Service (ALS) of Envoy. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

- `false`: disables the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: AccessLogServiceHost
parameters.description: The endpoint of the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

parameters.name: AccessLogServicePort
parameters.description: The port of the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

parameters.name: AccessLogSidecarEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the sidecar proxy to Simple Log Service.

parameters.name: AccessLogSidecarLifecycle
parameters.description: The retention period of the access logs of the sidecar proxy that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days.

parameters.name: AuditProject
parameters.description:
The SLS project that is used for mesh audit.

Default value: `mesh-log-{meshId}`.

parameters.name: AutoInjectionPolicyEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations. Valid values:

- `true`: enables automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations.

- `false`: disables automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: CRAggregationEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable data plane clusters to access Istio resources using the Kubernetes API. This feature is available only for ASM instances of v1.9.7.93 or later.

parameters.name: CertChain
parameters.description: The certificate chain from the CA certificate to the root certificate. The certificate chain must contain at least two certificates.

parameters.name: ClusterSpec
parameters.description:
The instance type of the service mesh. Valid values:

- `standard`: Standard Edition.

- `enterprise`: Enterprise Edition.

- `ultimate`: Ultimate Edition.

parameters.name: CniEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Container Network Interface (CNI). Valid values:

- `true`: enables CNI.

- `false`: disables CNI.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: CniExcludeNamespaces
parameters.description: The namespaces that are excluded from CNI.

parameters.name: Concurrency
parameters.description: The degree of parallelism for the sidecar proxy on the data plane.

parameters.name: ConfigSourceEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use an external service registry. Valid values:

- `true`: uses an external service registry.

- `false`: does not use an external service registry.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: ConfigSourceNacosID
parameters.description: The ID of the Nacos instance.

parameters.name: CustomizedPrometheus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use a self-managed Prometheus instance. Valid values:

- `true`: uses a self-managed Prometheus instance.

- `false`: does not use a self-managed Prometheus instance.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: CustomizedZipkin
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use a self-managed Zipkin system. Valid values:

- `true`: uses a self-managed Zipkin system.

- `false`: does not use a self-managed Zipkin system.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: DNSProxyingEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable DNS proxying. Valid values:

- `true`: enables DNS proxying.

- `false`: disables DNS proxying.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: DefaultComponentsScheduleConfig
parameters.description:
The default scheduling configurations that ASM delivers to the data plane components. You can configure `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` in the JSON format.

> - Modifying this parameter is a high-risk operation. This operation restarts all data plane components in the ASM instance. Proceed with caution.
>
> - These configurations do not apply to ASM gateways. To configure scheduling for an ASM gateway, specify the scheduling configurations in the gateway settings.

parameters.name: DiscoverySelectors
parameters.description: The label selectors for the namespaces of the data plane. The selectors are used for selective service discovery.

parameters.name: DubboFilterEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Dubbo filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Dubbo filter.

- `false`: disables the Dubbo filter.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: EnableAudit
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable mesh audit. To enable this feature, you must activate [Simple Log Service](https://sls.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables mesh audit.

- `false`: disables mesh audit.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: EnableAutoDiagnosis
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic diagnostics for the service mesh. If you enable this feature, the service mesh is automatically diagnosed when you modify an Istio resource in the service mesh.

parameters.name: EnableBootstrapXdsAgent
parameters.description: Specifies whether to load the bootstrap configurations before the sidecar proxy starts.

parameters.name: EnableCRHistory
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the history revision management feature for Istio resources in Service Mesh (ASM).

parameters.name: EnableNamespacesByDefault
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces. Valid values:

- `true`: enables automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces.

- `false`: disables automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: EnableSDSServer
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Secret Discovery Service (SDS). Valid values:

- `true`: enables the SDS.

- `false`: disables the SDS.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: ExcludeIPRanges
parameters.description: The IP address ranges for which outbound traffic is not intercepted.

parameters.name: ExcludeInboundPorts
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of inbound ports that are excluded from redirection.

parameters.name: ExcludeOutboundPorts
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of outbound ports that are excluded from redirection.

parameters.name: ExistingCaCert
parameters.description: The new CA certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

parameters.name: ExistingCaKey
parameters.description: The new CA key. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

parameters.name: ExistingRootCaCert
parameters.description: The new root certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

parameters.name: FilterGatewayClusterConfig
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable gateway configuration filtering. Valid values:

- `true`: enables gateway configuration filtering.

- `false`: disables gateway configuration filtering.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: GatewayAPIEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Gateway API. Valid values:

- `true`: enables Gateway API.

- `false`: disables Gateway API.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: HoldApplicationUntilProxyStarts
parameters.description: Specifies whether to wait for the sidecar proxy container to start before the application container starts when a pod is being started.

parameters.name: Http10Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable support for HTTP 1.0. Valid values:

- `true`: enables support for HTTP 1.0.

- `false`: disables support for HTTP 1.0.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: IncludeIPRanges
parameters.description: The IP address ranges for which outbound traffic is intercepted.

parameters.name: IncludeInboundPorts
parameters.description: The inbound ports for which traffic is redirected to the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: IncludeOutboundPorts
parameters.description: The outbound ports for which traffic is redirected to the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: IntegrateKiali
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance for accessing the ASM mesh topology.

parameters.name: InterceptionMode
parameters.description:
The mode of inbound traffic interception by the sidecar proxy. Valid values:

- `REDIRECT`: the default interception mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using redirection.

- `TPROXY`: the transparent proxy mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using a transparent proxy.

parameters.name: KialiArmsAuthTokens
parameters.description:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and use ARMS Prometheus to collect metrics, and the ARMS Prometheus instance has a token-based authentication configuration, you can use this parameter to specify the authentication token. This authorizes the mesh topology to access the ARMS Prometheus instance.
The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the authentication token of the ARMS Prometheus instance that is installed in the data plane cluster.

parameters.name: KialiEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the mesh topology feature. To enable this feature, you must first enable Prometheus to collect metrics. If you disable Prometheus to collect metrics, this feature is forcibly disabled. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the mesh topology feature.

- `false`: disables the mesh topology feature.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: KialiServiceAnnotations
parameters.description:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and create a CLB instance to access the mesh topology, you can use this parameter to configure the CLB instance for the mesh topology service in different clusters using annotations.

The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the annotation of the mesh topology service in the data plane cluster.

For more information about how to configure a CLB instance using annotations, see <props="intl">[Use annotations to configure a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/container-service-for-kubernetes/latest/use-annotations-to-configure-load-balancing-1)</props>.

parameters.name: LabelsForOffloadedWorkloads
parameters.description: The labels of the workloads that are offloaded.

parameters.name: Lifecycle
parameters.description: The lifecycle of the istio-proxy container.

parameters.name: LocalityLBConf
LocalityLoadBalancing
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable locality-based load balancing. Valid values:

- `true`: enables locality-based load balancing.

- `false`: disables locality-based load balancing.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: LogLevel
parameters.description: The log level of the sidecar proxy on the data plane. The log levels are sorted in ascending order of the log verbosity: `none`, `error`, `warn`, `info`, and `debug`.

parameters.name: MSEEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Microservices Engine (MSE). Valid values:

- `true`: enables MSE.

- `false`: disables MSE.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: MultiBufferEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the MultiBuffer-based acceleration feature.

parameters.name: MultiBufferPollDelay
parameters.description: The polling delay for the MultiBuffer feature. The default value is empty.

parameters.name: MysqlFilterEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the MySQL filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the MySQL filter.

- `false`: disables the MySQL filter.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: NFDEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable automatic node feature discovery.

parameters.name: NFDLabelPruned
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove the feature labels from nodes when you disable automatic node feature discovery.

This parameter is required only when you set `NFDEnabled` to `false`.

parameters.name: OPAInjectorCPULimit
parameters.description: The maximum number of CPU cores that are allowed for the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

parameters.name: OPAInjectorCPURequirement
parameters.description: The minimum number of CPU cores that are requested by the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

parameters.name: OPAInjectorMemoryLimit
parameters.description: The maximum memory that is allowed for the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1024Mi` indicates 1024 MB.

parameters.name: OPAInjectorMemoryRequirement
parameters.description: The minimum memory that is requested by the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `50Mi` indicates 50 MB.

parameters.name: OPALimitCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resource limit of the OPA proxy container.

parameters.name: OPALimitMemory
parameters.description: The memory resource limit of the OPA proxy container.

parameters.name: OPALogLevel
parameters.description:
The log level of the OPA proxy container. Valid values:

- `info`: outputs all information.

- `debug`: outputs debugging information and error messages.

- `error`: outputs only error messages.

parameters.name: OPARequestCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resource request of the OPA proxy container.

parameters.name: OPARequestMemory
parameters.description: The memory resource request of the OPA proxy container.

parameters.name: OPAScopeInjected
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable OPA injection scope control. Valid values:

- `true`: enables OPA injection scope control.

- `false`: disables OPA injection scope control.

parameters.name: OpaEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable OPA. Valid values:

- `true`: enables OPA.

- `false`: disables OPA.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: OpenAgentPolicy
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to integrate with the Open Policy Agent (OPA) plug-in. Valid values:

- `true`: integrates with the OPA plug-in.

- `false`: does not integrate with the OPA plug-in.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: OutboundTrafficPolicy
parameters.description:
The policy for accessing external services. Valid values:

- `ALLOW_ANY`: allows access to all external services.

- `REGISTRY_ONLY`: allows access to only the services that are registered with the service mesh.

parameters.name: PilotEnableQuicListeners
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable HTTP/3 support.

parameters.name: PrometheusUrl
parameters.description: The endpoint of the Prometheus service. If you do not use a self-managed Prometheus instance, use the endpoint of an ARMS Prometheus instance.

parameters.name: ProxyInitCPUResourceLimit
parameters.description: The CPU resource limit of the istio-init container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitCPUResourceRequest
parameters.description: The CPU resource request of the istio-init container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitMemoryResourceLimit
parameters.description: The memory resource limit of the istio-init container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitMemoryResourceRequest
parameters.description: The memory resource request of the istio-init container.

parameters.name: ProxyLimitCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resource limit.

parameters.name: ProxyLimitMemory
parameters.description: The memory resource limit.

parameters.name: ProxyRequestCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resources required by the proxy.

parameters.name: ProxyRequestMemory
parameters.description: The memory resources required by the proxy.

parameters.name: ProxyStatsMatcher
parameters.description: The additional metrics that are reported by the sidecar proxy on the data plane.

parameters.name: RedisFilterEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Redis filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Redis filter.

- `false`: disables the Redis filter.
  Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: SMCEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to install SMC acceleration.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId
parameters.description: The ID of the service mesh.

parameters.name: SidecarInjectorLimitCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resource limit of the sidecar injector pod.

parameters.name: SidecarInjectorLimitMemory
parameters.description: The memory resource limit of the sidecar injector pod.

parameters.name: SidecarInjectorRequestCPU
parameters.description: The CPU resource request of the sidecar injector pod.

parameters.name: SidecarInjectorRequestMemory
parameters.description: The memory resource request of the sidecar injector pod.

parameters.name: SidecarInjectorWebhookAsYaml
parameters.description: Other configurations for automatic sidecar proxy injection. The value must be in the YAML format.

parameters.name: Telemetry
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Prometheus to collect metrics. We recommend that you use [Managed Service for Prometheus](https://arms.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables Prometheus to collect metrics.

- `false`: disables Prometheus to collect metrics.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: TerminationDrainDuration
parameters.description: The duration for which the istio-proxy container waits for connections to drain before termination. For example, a value of 5s indicates 5 seconds.

parameters.name: ThriftFilterEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the Thrift filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Thrift filter.

- `false`: disables the Thrift filter.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: TraceCustomTags
TraceMaxPathTagLength
parameters.description: The maximum length of the URI of the request that is contained in the \`HttpUrl\` span tag. Default value: `256`.

parameters.name: TraceSampling
parameters.description: The sampling percentage for Tracing Analysis.

parameters.name: Tracing
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Tracing Analysis. To enable this feature, you must activate [Managed Service for OpenTelemetry](https://tracing-analysis.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables Tracing Analysis.

- `false`: disables Tracing Analysis.

Default value: `false`.

parameters.name: TracingOnExtZipkinLimitCPU
parameters.description: The maximum number of CPU cores that are allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

parameters.name: TracingOnExtZipkinLimitMemory
parameters.description: The maximum memory that is allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1Mi` indicates 1 MB.

parameters.name: TracingOnExtZipkinReplicaCount
parameters.description: The number of replicas for the proxy service that exports Tracing Analysis data.

parameters.name: TracingOnExtZipkinRequestCPU
parameters.description: The minimum number of CPU cores that are requested by the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

parameters.name: TracingOnExtZipkinRequestMemory
parameters.description: The minimum memory that is requested by the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1Mi` indicates 1 MB.

parameters.name: WebAssemblyFilterEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the WebAssembly filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the WebAssembly filter.

- `false`: disables the WebAssembly filter.

Default value: `false`.
